headlines.title: Bay Area weather updates: Pacifica flood cleanup, king tides, coastal flood warning
headlines.description: King tides continue to crash into California’s coast, sparking several weather alerts and issues in the Bay Area. Here’s a look at the latest weather-related incidents NBC Bay Area is monitoring: Coastal flood warning issued in Bay Area A coastal flood warning is in effect until 4 p.m. Thursday. View the latest weather alerts here. King tides damage Pacifica seawall, flood neighborhood Pacifica city crews and residents continue to prepare for more possible king tides flooding after giant waves took out a part of a pier, damaged a portion of a seawall and caused flooding in a neighborhood. King tides flood Marin County roadways bay area storm 13 hours ago Pacifica 7 hours ago Pacifica 6 hours ago Massive waves, king tides flood Pacifica's Sharp Park neighborhood
